definitions: Allowed the existence, occurrence, or practice of (something that one does not necessarily like or agree with) without interference.
Endured or put up with (someone or something unpleasant or annoying).
Showed willingness to allow the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with without interference.
Accepted or endured (a drug, food, or environmental condition) without adverse reaction.
examples: Such behaviour will not be tolerated.
He tolerated her for the sake of their children.
The plant tolerates a wide range of soil conditions.
Some patients tolerated the treatment better than others.
